fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-01-03 at roughly 17:30, it was reported that a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 1,20,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation. Kishore Velan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000140. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100086. The complainant alleged that Vasanth Gopal may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000245. The complainant mentioned a bank transaction reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00258, as the mobile number 9000000245 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported unauthorised debits after sharing details during a call.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, suspect, receiving account, mobile number, evening, shopping complex, bank reference
